title: for walks the lines of a text file in batches, as line() reads them
purpose: Observe host-resource behaviour inside the case's isolated working directory.

provenance.origin: authored for #352/#465 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: fs/file: a line loses its LF and one CR before it, a final unterminated line is a line; for over file.text() yields the same lines as line(), and lines() is the rest as an array.
